title: Build 13 interrupted by Java memory exhaustion
summary: The previous build attempt failed before producing a verified APK. A retry uses one worker and a bounded Java heap.

changes.detail: Continued release validation for the saved phone session recovery changes; retry uses one Gradle worker, disables parallel execution and runs Kotlin compilation in process.

validation.name: Previous native build
validation.detail: Saved log reports native memory allocation failures and an unexpectedly terminated Gradle daemon.

validation.name: Focused viewer and change history tests
validation.detail: 11 tests passed on this continuation, including hidden viewer pause/resume and transient network recovery.

validation.name: TypeScript, focused lint and history integrity
validation.detail: Typecheck and lint of app/phone.tsx and components/PhoneViewer.tsx completed without errors; 147 history reports validated before this append.

validation.name: Replacement APK and physical phones
validation.detail: Retry in progress. No ADB device connected; two-phone Home/app-switch acceptance remains untested. No deployment performed.
